name: Namecheap
summary: Namecheap is a large, well-known domain registrar with free lifetime WHOIS privacy and a wide range of add-on services.

free_plan_covers.note: Namecheap has no free plan; every domain is a paid purchase billed once a year.

first_paid_usd_month.note: There's no monthly plan; domains are billed once a year, not monthly.

portability.note: You unlock the domain and get its auth code from your account yourself, and Namecheap has 5 days to release it once a transfer starts, though ICANN still requires the domain to be registered at least 60 days first.

com_first_year_usd.note: A new .com is on sale for $11.28 for the first year, 25% off the $14.98 list price shown on the same page.

com_renewal_usd.note: Renewal is $18.48 a year, well above the first-year sale price.

whois_privacy_free.note: Namecheap includes free-for-life domain privacy protection on every eligible domain, including .com.

dns_included.note: Free BasicDNS management (plus DNSSEC) is included when the domain uses Namecheap's own nameservers.

setup.step: Search for and register the domain at namecheap.com.
In Domain List, open the domain's Advanced DNS tab and add the host records your host gives you.
Add any TXT, SPF, DKIM or DMARC records your email service gives you the same way.

builder_notes: Add the host's records and the email service's SPF, DKIM and DMARC records in Advanced DNS before assuming the site or outgoing email works.
Budget for the $18.48/year renewal price, not the discounted first-year sale price shown at signup.
